verdicts.claim: Nike closed its 529 Broadway SoHo flagship on Jan 10, 2026, and opened a temporary 40,000-square-foot store at 611 Broadway on April 16.
verdicts.note: Hypebeast, amNY and Hoodline confirm the Jan 10 closure (the building went to IKEA's parent) and the April 16, 2026 opening at 611 Broadway, across from adidas. Retailboss gives 40,217 sq ft. No end date for the temporary lease was found.

verdicts.claim: Jimmy Jazz reopened its 239 W. 125th Street flagship with more than 150 sneaker styles.
verdicts.note: The only source is an undated Patch piece about a Cam'Ron-hosted reopening, which other coverage puts around 2017. Nothing confirms the store is trading in 2026. Rewrote the insight, the 125th Street place and the door as 'confirm it is open'.

verdicts.claim: The brief routes ring night and the park-circuit opportunities through Jimmy Jazz, 239 W. 125th St.
verdicts.note: The store's current status could not be confirmed (latest reopening news is years old). The brief already says 'confirm it is open'; keep that hedge or name a second Harlem door as backup.

verdicts.claim: The June 18, 2026 parade up the Canyon of Heroes was the franchise's first ticker-tape parade.
verdicts.note: Fox 5, 6sqft and AP confirm the Thursday, June 18 ticker-tape parade, ending at City Hall with Mayor Zohran Mamdani's Key to the City ceremony. It was the Knicks' first ever.

verdicts.claim: MSG Sports has reportedly planned a spin-off of the Knicks into a separate public company.
verdicts.note: It is the Rangers that are being spun off. The MSG Sports board approved the split on Sept 30, 2026, with completion expected Oct 26. MSG Sports is renamed MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (Knicks and Westchester Knicks), and Dolan runs both companies. Fixed in fanbase.json.

verdicts.claim: The Oakley lawsuit is still active.
verdicts.note: Judge Sullivan granted MSG summary judgment on Oakley's remaining assault claims in summer 2026, and Oakley owes about $642,000 in sanctions. His lawyers say they will push for a jury trial. Dolan was dropped as a defendant in 2020. Rewrote the line.

verdicts.claim: Dolan has an open dispute with City Hall over watch parties near the Garden.
verdicts.note: In June 2026 MSG dropped its Game 4 Finals watch party, and Dolan blamed Mayor Mamdani and the NYPD. Mamdani said the city approved a 999-person permit. Kept, with the June timing added.

verdicts.claim: The Kith x Nike Air Max 95 'Knicks' went out through a Kith app draw that closed June 10, 2026.
verdicts.note: Hypebeast and Complex confirm the adult-size draw on the Kith app, closing June 10, 2026, at $220, made to order. The pair first came out in kids' sizes in 2025.

verdicts.claim: A Brunson x Kobe 5 Protro 'NY vs. NY' colorway came out in 2026.
verdicts.note: It debuted in a tiny run during the Finals at Nike's activation across from the Garden, then got a wider release on Aug 4, 2026, at $190 (one listing says $200).

verdicts.claim: SI ranked the Knicks' Specter sixth of eight and called the look a fifth-grade doodle.
verdicts.note: SI's worst-to-best ranking of the eight Specter sets exists, and SI called the batch mostly hideous. Search could not confirm the Knicks' rank or the 'doodle' line. Removed both specifics and softened 'harshest of the eight' in the summary.

verdicts.claim: Leaked Specter designs drew the harshest reviews of the eight, and SI ranked the Knicks sixth.
verdicts.note: The Knicks' rank could not be confirmed. If it was sixth on a worst-to-best list, it was not the harshest-reviewed set, so the two halves clash. Say Specter as a whole drew harsh reviews and drop the rank.

verdicts.claim: The Knicks are one of eight historic franchises getting Specter uniforms; early reaction was largely negative.
verdicts.note: NBC and SI coverage lists Celtics, Hawks, Kings, Knicks, Lakers, Pistons, Warriors and 76ers. Reaction pieces on Sept 10 describe widespread criticism.

verdicts.claim: The SLAM Summer Classic Vol. 8 played Rucker Park on Aug 17, 2026.
verdicts.note: NBA.com previews Vol. 8 on Monday, Aug 17, 2026, at Rucker: girls at 6 p.m., boys at 7:45 p.m., on NBA TV. It was the fifth straight year at Rucker, with a four-shoe SLAM x Nike pack.

verdicts.claim: Teyana Taylor curated Dyckman Basketball's 2026 takeover.
verdicts.note: The Baller Alert source is undated, and search found no 2026 Dyckman event with her. Taylor's Dyckman ties are real (she has run a team there). Dropped '2026' from the place and person entries.

verdicts.claim: NCAA East Regional at MSG, hosted by St. John's, on Mar 26 and 28, 2027.
verdicts.note: St. John's and the Big East announced they will host the 2027 East Regional at the Garden. Ticket listings give Mar 26 and Mar 28, 2027, with times TBD.

verdicts.claim: Westchester Knicks home opener, Nov 14, 2026, at the County Center (provisional).
verdicts.note: Only a resale listing shows Greensboro at Westchester on Nov 14 at 3 p.m.; no team release was found. The dossier already marks it provisional, so it stays as written.

verdicts.claim: Rough Trade NYC has two floors since 2025: Rough Trade Above at street level and Rough Trade Below on the Rink Level.
verdicts.note: Rockefeller Center and Retail Week confirm the 4,000-sq-ft Rough Trade Below opened in April 2025 on the Rink Level of 30 Rockefeller Plaza. The street shop became Rough Trade Above.

verdicts.claim: Time Out Market New York hosts a free RSVP ring-night watch party.
verdicts.note: The Dumbo market is open (Chicago and Boston closed, leaving New York). No listing for the ring-night watch party turned up. Reworded as 'reportedly' with a confirm-first note.

verdicts.claim: Ronnie Fieg has been the Knicks' first creative director since November 2022.
verdicts.note: Consistent with the 2026 Kith draw coverage, which frames the Air Max 95 around his Knicks role. No change.

verdicts.claim: Kith released a New Balance 993 Knicks pack in late 2025, then the adult Air Max 95 in June 2026.
verdicts.note: The Air Max 95 draw is confirmed for June 2026. Sneaker News covered the Kith Air Max 95 in November 2025. The 993 pack was not separately searched.

verdicts.claim: Mayor Zohran Mamdani is the city's current mayor and hosted the parade's City Hall ceremony.
verdicts.note: Parade coverage names Mamdani hosting the Key to the City ceremony and riding the bus with Brunson and Towns.

verdicts.claim: Opening night Oct 20 vs. Philadelphia, Christmas noon vs. San Antonio, MLK Day Jan 18 vs. Minnesota at 5 p.m., Cup East Group B.
verdicts.note: Matches the verified 2026-27 league calendar supplied with this run. No change needed.

verdicts.claim: Ownership notes in the brief describe the Dolan story as watch parties and Specter friction.
verdicts.note: Add the Sept 30 board approval to spin the Rangers off from the Knicks (done Oct 26, MSG Sports becomes MSG Knickerbockers Corp.) wherever the brief discusses ownership. The Oakley case is no longer 'active' in the usual sense; claims were dismissed in summer 2026.

verdicts.claim: Dick's now owns the Foot Locker chain.
verdicts.note: Dick's Sporting Goods closed its Foot Locker acquisition in September 2025. Not re-searched this run; consistent with current reporting.

summary: Twenty-four high-risk claims checked with 19 searches. The dossiers hold up on the big facts: the 611 Broadway Nike store, the June 18 parade, the Kith Air Max 95 draw, the Brunson Kobe 5 'NY vs. NY', SLAM Summer Classic Vol. 8, Rough Trade's two floors and the 2027 East Regional dates. Two ownership lines were wrong: the spin-off separates the Rangers from the Knicks (approved Sept 30, done Oct 26), and Oakley's claims were dismissed in summer 2026. Three claims leaned on undated or unconfirmed sources and were softened: Jimmy Jazz's 'reopening', Teyana Taylor's '2026' Dyckman takeover and the SI 'sixth of eight, fifth-grade doodle' Specter rank. The brief should hedge Jimmy Jazz, drop the Specter rank and add the spin-off.
